mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing immediate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through lower aggregate demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) combined with elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth above 105.0 for three consecutive months signals robust manufacturing output that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through stronger economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.0 for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) declining more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months indicates weakening retail demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through lower earnings growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines exceed 0.5% MoM for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through weaker economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5% q/q) combined with declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates a supply shock during expansion, disrupting corporate production and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced output and margin pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% and INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
